name: values-rows
title: Values rows
description: Company values as hairline rows: the value in large type, its meaning in a sentence, and a concrete We do and We do not pair.
docs: Pass an eyebrow, a title and three to six values. Each value needs a name, a one-sentence meaning, and one behaviour for does and one for doesNot, each checkable in a day at work; the component asks for the pair so a bare list is not possible. A value with an href gets a link under its pair, set with labels.more and routed with linkAs. Rows are an ordered list with an index, and stack on a phone with the name first. The two columns carry their own icon and words, so neither relies on colour. headingLevel is the section title's level; the value names sit one below it.
